main_text.p: בפריע Cito, Celeriter : למפרע Retrò, Præposterè.
פרצוף פרץ Vultus, Facies, Effigies, Figura, Persona. Ex Græco πρόσωπον [?] : Plut. פרצופין Gen.1.27. in Raschi.
פרקליטא פרק Consolator. Plur. פרקליטין R.D. 2.Sam.24. v.15. פרקמטיא Mercatura, Negotiatio, Eccles.4. v.8. in R.Salom.
פרר, פרר Conterere, Comminuere. התפרר Comminui. פרורין, פררות פרפורין Minutia, mica.
פרש Explicare, פירוש Explicatio, Commentarius. מפרש Interpres, Commentator. בפירוש In Commentario : Item, Clare, distinctè.

הפרש פרש Separare se, Discedere : Distinguere, Dividere. הפרש Discrimen, Differentia. אפרשו Separatio. פרשה Separatio, Sectio. Sic vocantur Sectiones Legis Mosaicæ, quæ, à triplici פ vel ם majusculo incipiunt. Item Versus quilibet Biblicus sic vocatur, ut in Kimchi, Amos 1.11. פרישים Calcaria, à pungendo. Nam הפריש Pungere, Prov.23.32. Inde Kimchi, פרשים Equites appellantur, שמפרישים בפרישים שברגליהם quia punguut calcaribus, quæ sunt in pedibus ipsorum, Iud.3.31.

פשט Extendere, Diffundere se : התפשט Diffundi, Effundi, Effluere, Extendi. פשוט Nudum, Simplex, ut Elementa, cœli & corpora simplicia : item Vulgare : שם פשוט Nomen simplex & absolutum, cujus oppositum מורכב Compositum : מנהג פשוט Consuetudo vulgaris. שם המופשט Nomen abstractum. הפשט Simplicitas. פשוט פשט Simplex, Literalis vocis aut loci alicujus sensus. על דרך הפשט Iuxta literalem sensum, cui opponitur מדרש Allegoricus & mysticus sensus. page.notes: The Hebrew and Greek were read from a small, slightly blurred scan; vowel points and some letters in the Hebrew may be misread, so Hebrew forms should be checked against the original. The Greek word after "Ex Græco" is uncertain. The "ooo" mark below the text is a printer's ornament and was left out. The last line ends with a printed hyphen ("sen-"), which continues on the next page. Printed spellings such as "Discedere", "Distinguere" and "Mosaicæ" are copied as they appear.
